cases.name: Larisa Dumansky
cases.about: She was an Ukrainian immigrant. who worked at the John Morrell & Company meat packing plant.
cases.narrative:
He abducted her from her workplace parking lot.

In August 1997, Anderson's cellmate provided key information that Anderson had boasted about kidnapping, raping, and murdering both Larisa Dumansky and Piper Streyle.

Anderson told Brunner he kidnapped Dumansky at knifepoint with his friend Glen Walker's help but Walker went home after getting scared. Anderson then raped Dumansky in a field in a rural area and after doing so wrapped her head with duct tape, covering her mouth and nose so she suffocated. He then went to get Walker, who assisted in her burial. 

Glen Marcus Walker, who was Anderson's lifelong friend, led law enforcement to a shallow grave site in McCook County near Lake Vermilion. The grave site contained shell casings and bone fragments. DNA testing was carried out and showed the bones were a genetic match to Larisa Dumansky. Police believe Anderson and Walker buried Dumansky in the grave.
